appliedAreaAnchor.name: Fredriksten
appliedAreaAnchor.finding: The named historic-site and castle area represents the main Fredriksten fortress complex and provides a stable area anchor rather than one building, gate or information sign.

officialIdentity.finding: Forsvarsbygg identifies Fredriksten as a national fortified cultural monument and living public fortress area, begun in 1661 after the loss of Bohuslän.

officialHistoricalScope.finding: The official history connects the fortress to the strategic border landscape after 1658 and documents its development as a multi-part defensive complex rather than a single building.

heritageCrossCheck.finding: The independent fortress entity publishes a point approximately 42.3 metres from the applied area anchor and links Kulturminne ID 122685.

falseCandidate.finding: A newer same-name object is an information sign and is rejected because it cannot represent the fortress complex.

radiusDecision.finding: The retained radius covers the main fortress, central courtyards, buildings, walls and nearby outworks at gameplay scale. It is not the legal protection boundary or the complete historic defensive landscape around Halden.

decision.representationLimit: The marker represents the named main fortress complex. Detached forts, approach works and the wider battlefield and border landscape remain contextual extents rather than one exact circular geometry.
